evidence_planes.embedded: Evidence generated before freeze and committed with the candidate.
evidence_planes.external: Write-once evidence generated from or against the exact frozen commit without changing that commit or rebuilding its archive.

states.description: Implementation work is incomplete and no publication claim is made.
states.name: draft

states.description: A reviewable implementation exists, but one or more release gates are not passed.
states.name: candidate

states.description: Every embedded candidate and validation gate is passed. The exact commit may now be frozen for external reproduction and security evidence.
states.name: validated

states.description: The validated frozen commit has passed external clean-room reproduction and security checks, the Explorer prerequisite release is bound, and the same archive bytes have been published as an immutable release candidate.
states.name: rc

states.description: The RC has passed post-RC public validation and the exact RC filename and bytes have been promoted. A write-once external finalization receipt binds the complete chain.
states.name: published
